note: $Globals layouts for Unity's TMP shaders.  Each entry is the constant-buffer layout fxc produces from Unity's own CGIncludes compiled with -D SHADER_API_D3D11, read back from the RDEF section; tools/gen_tmp_layout.py generated it.  The macro matters: CBUFFER_START only becomes a cbuffer under D3D11, and without it the PerCamera/PerDraw globals get folded into $Globals (3072 bytes) which matches nothing in the build.
